1.explanation:
• ComboBox/tools: contains the Combobox setup and example scripts where the onClick is wired up and the list is populated via AJAX.  
• ListBox/README.md: shows how the ListBox and its internal Field and Menu components toggle visibility and fire events.  
• ListItem/: holds the implementation of each dropdown item; useful for verifying that items are rendered only after onClick.  
• Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx: documents the dropdown trigger logic and icon button behavior, which ComboBox reuses for its arrow.  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx: Combobox uses a TextInput under the hood; this doc covers how clicks on the input field are handled.  
• Button/Button.mdx: the arrow is rendered inside a button element; this file explains default onClick behavior and focus handling that may differ from the input’s.
1.bug_scenario: The Combobox’s down‐arrow icon flips on first click but does not fire the component’s onClick handler, so the list never populates. Only after you click the input field itself does the AJAX callback run and populate the list; any subsequent arrow clicks then work because the list is already loaded. The three screenshots show (1) first arrow click with an empty dropdown, (2) clicking the input field and seeing the populated list, and (3) the arrow’s click target on the right side of the greyed placeholder input.
